changelog: 4 numbers changed: day_visit_share_local, gulf_stays, mean_nights, stays

questions: How many days does a maintenance request take to close in each park, and how far do the parks differ once the category of request is the same?
Do requests that needed more crew visits get lower ratings from the resident who reported them?

fixed.check: Bootstrap of 156 weeks: 95% interval about 0.60 to 0.78.
fixed.finding: Weeks with more ticket sales are weeks with fuller hotels (correlation 0.70).
fixed.limit: Summer and festivals raise both series; the data does not show that site visits fill hotels.

fixed.check: Baseline from the 2023 seasonal shape and the median yearly growth; all other months within 5% of it.
fixed.finding: The three festival months stood 18% to 29% above the seasonal baseline.
fixed.limit: Three festival months and one choice of baseline; other events in those months are not ruled out.

fixed.check: Means by origin, and the 2025 mean recomputed at the 2024 mix of visitors (4.25).
fixed.finding: Satisfaction rose in every origin market from 2024 to 2025 while the overall mean fell from 4.15 to 4.07.
fixed.limit: Survey respondents choose to answer; the mix is taken from the respondents, not from all visitors.

fixed.check: Largest of 27 site-year gaps; p = 0.03 taken alone; a gap that large appears among 27 in about half of shuffles.
fixed.finding: At the Honey Museum, weekend visitors were more satisfied than weekday visitors in 2025 (gap 0.30).
fixed.limit: Found by searching 27 comparisons; to be tested on the 2026 survey before any announcement.

fixed.check: Question written down before the 2024 survey was opened; 2025 difference +0.39, interval +0.31 to +0.47.
fixed.finding: Guided visits were rated about 0.4 point higher than unguided ones in 2025.
fixed.limit: Visitors choose a guided visit; the data does not show that guiding causes the higher rating.
